comment: Website-local (not a desktop vector): §11.5 takedown read-resolution. Drives resolveVersionRow directly (DB-only, no archive on disk needed). The published top (v3) is taken down (available='N'); an explicit read of it is 410 Gone, an explicit read of a still-available v2 is served, and the PIN (no version) walks DOWN past the taken-down top to the next-lower available version (v2) — the read-time fallback, with current_version left at 3 as a ceiling (INV-17: takedown is not a re-pin). A read of a nonexistent v9 is still 404.
